responsibility: Implements trait-aware autodereferencing over types for the trait-selection layer. This root file defines the iterator that walks successive deref steps from a base type, handling both built-in dereferences and overloaded `Deref`-based dereferences, accumulating any trait obligations needed to justify overloaded steps, exposing the resulting step sequence and final type to callers such as method lookup and type operations, and reporting recursion-limit failures encountered during autoderef search.
